title: 8 Marks of a Godly Man Whose Humility Is Actually Being Formed
caption:
8 marks of a godly man whose humility is actually being formed, not performed.

He asks before he assumes he already knows. He can be corrected without going quiet for a week. He gives the harder job to someone else and means it. His apology doesn't come with a "but" attached to the end.

Formed humility doesn't need an audience. It looks the same behind a closed door as it does in front of everyone else, because God already saw that version.

"But when you pray, go into your room, close the door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen." (Matthew 6:6)

Save this and run yourself through it today.
